behaviorContracts.semantics: cn/clsx add number and dictionary handling; twJoin/twMerge accept strings and nested arrays. Runtime JS array-like values follow the original engine, independent of public TypeScript narrowing.
Mutable arrays/dictionaries cannot be cached by object identity; replay changed values.
Undefined, transform function, complete config, and extension forms retain their resolution behavior and exception boundaries.
Clone the base, apply prefix, then override fields, then append extensions in definition order.
Function validators use stable registry identities; unknown markers throw. Theme-getter functions remain distinct from predicates.
Classify full candidates with prefix, modifier/bracket/parenthesis, important and slash handling; keep reached groups and directed conflict metadata.
Default, subset, empty, empty-tail, duplicate, escaped and Unicode literal tables must match in-memory compilation for JS and TS emissions.
Custom validator functions run in-memory; serialized module emission explicitly throws.
Ignored directories can be explicitly opted into except .git; follow symlinks, avoid ancestor cycles, count unreadable paths.
Pure changed-path matching follows literal/glob/ignored-directory rules and rejects paths outside cwd.
Candidate extraction is over-approximation; count tokens skipped above the fixed 8192-character cap.
Defaults, tokens/full scan suppression, CSS theme registration before custom config, safelist, source/self-symlink exclusion and output extension affect build semantics.
Identical source leaves the output file untouched and reports changed=false; warnings and errors remain observable.
Coalesce concurrent runs; class edits reaching dropped groups rebuild, existing groups/deleted sources do not; CSS theme dependencies trigger rebuild.
Read @theme namespaces/reset/removal/subproperties, relative CSS imports and cycles, and report every file; package imports are not followed.
Build tables before resolution, update from changed source files, and ignore delete events.
Build before returning object/function config; development watches recursively with nonpersistent watcher and reports changed-file errors.
CLI argument parsing and display adapt the core build; errors print cn: and exit nonzero; help/version remain tool concerns.
Wide conflict fan-out, arbitrary group IDs above 8191 and raw-prefix reset must retain correctness and termination.
Epoch int32 wrap and epoch zero require explicit seeded-state tests under a timeout.

Native compiler table/source, build warnings/errors and plugin/CLI adapter mapping need per-entry equivalence evidence.
Bounds/hardening/cache/property fuzz remain pending Rust verification even if the reference execution succeeds.
